about: Rules for scripts/release-check.mjs, which checks the release build (frontend/out) before npm run aws:deploy publishes it. Whenever you spot something players shouldn't see, add it here so it can never ship again. Text rules match the HTML, the page data (.txt) and the JavaScript bundles. deployOnly rules are skipped by npm run preview:release.
